description_fr: BNY (The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation, NYSE : BK), anciennement BNY Mellon, est une banque dépositaire et un gestionnaire d'actifs américain fondé en 1784. Son modèle repose principalement sur des revenus de commissions tirés de la conservation et de l'administration d'actifs (AUC/A de 59,4 milliers de milliards de dollars au premier trimestre 2026) ainsi que de la gestion d'actifs (AUM de 2,1 milliers de milliards). L'activité est organisée en trois segments : Securities Services (services aux titres, conservation, services aux émetteurs), Market and Wealth Services (compensation, gestion des garanties, Pershing, services de gestion de fortune) et Investment and Wealth Management (gestion d'actifs et de patrimoine).
description_en: BNY (The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation, NYSE: BK), formerly BNY Mellon, is an American custody bank and asset manager founded in 1784. Its model is driven mainly by fee revenue from the custody and administration of assets (AUC/A of $59.4 trillion as of the first quarter of 2026) and from asset management (AUM of $2.1 trillion). The business is organized into three segments: Securities Services (custody, issuer services), Market and Wealth Services (clearance, collateral management, Pershing, wealth services) and Investment and Wealth Management (asset and wealth management).
